verdict.rationale: 2FAS's homepage claims 'Token customization: Full control over the groups, badges, icons, and labels', which covers groups and service icons for organizing many tokens. That claim is a single marketing line with no in-depth docs or hands-on corroboration, and nothing in the pack mentions search. Missing for 10: evidence of token search, detailed docs on how groups and folders work, evidence of quick-access ('two taps') usability, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
